auditRules: Process every PDF page in every archive member.
Preserve archive path, member path, page or row locator, and content hash.
Do not assume content families are confined to headings or dedicated sections.
Treat examples, sidebars, prose, tables, appendices, setting text, and encounter material as possible mechanical evidence.
Detect duplicate source members before counting corpus coverage.
Do not promote extracted findings to canon without review.
